items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 27 at 4:52AM EST until November 27 at 11:00AM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Broward County and Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
